snippet.description:
"Tomorrow is Halloween! 🎃
What will the weather be like?"

멋진 코스튬을 입은 아이들과 함께
내일의 날씨를 상상해 보세요 ☁️🌦️💨

종이 책을 넘기는 소리와 성우들의 풍부한 목소리에 귀를 기울이다 보면,
어느새 영어 동화 속 세상에 푹 빠져들게 될 거예요. ☁️🌦️💨

en-US.title: 10 Minutes a Day | Math Mastery | Number Games | Early Childhood Math | Home Learning | Mom-led L...
en-US.description:
For your child's first math learning, how they encounter numbers and how much fun they have starting it is crucial.

This video is part of the ‘10 Minutes a Day Math Game Collection,’ designed to help children learn number concepts and operations—the most fundamental aspects of math learning—in a fun way through games.

Instead of simply memorizing numbers, this content guides children to compare the magnitudes of numbers within the game and naturally grasp the principles of operations. It contains enjoyable mathematical stimulation essential for the #4YearOldEducation, #5YearOldEducation, and #6YearOldEducation stages.

It is #HomeLearning that is effortless at home and requires only 10 minutes a day. It is math play that is more fun than studying, and it is #MomMadeMath #EarlyChildhoodEducation content that you can trust and show your child.
